title: 이어폰 한쪽
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad. Acoustic guitar plays a fingerstyle pattern with prominent string squeaks and a steady thumb-plucked bass line on the downbeats. A baritone male vocal performs in a breathy, intimate style with frequent use of vibrato and soft glissandos between notes. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the dry, close-miked guitar and the centered vocal. Tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. Key is G Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerstyle acoustic guitar with prominent string noise]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
슬리퍼를 끌고 나와서
엘리베이터 혼자 타는 밤
로비 불빛이 꺼져 있어 나만 깨어 있는 거야
가로등이 새겨져 있어

첫 번째를 지나면서
그림자가 앞서간다
나보다 먼저 걷는다
